rows.note: Use this for the performance or performing engagement itself, rather than for a general job.

example.english: Our band has a gig next Friday.
example.traditional: 我哋隊樂隊下星期五有場演出。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 ngok6 deoi6 haa6 sing1 kei4 ng5 jau5 coeng4 jin2 ceot1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a job or piece of work.

example.english: I took a gig organising documents for a company.
example.traditional: 我接咗份工作，幫間公司整理文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zip3 zo2 fan6 gung1 zok3 bong1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zing2 lei5 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this specifically for temporary, casual, or piecework employment rather than a regular job.

example.english: I found a gig today helping someone move house.
example.traditional: 我今日搵到份散工，幫人搬屋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 wan2 dou2 fan6 saan2 gung1 bong1 jan4 bun1 uk1
